# Field matrix rows that fail on master: case, invariant and the fix that
# turns the row green. TestSiteSimFieldMatrix fails when a listed row passes
# and when a row fails that is not listed. FTW_FIELD_KNOWN=write rewrites
# this file from a run, keeps each label and marks unlisted failures "new".
#
# A         srcfl/ftw#1799: room limits rises only; the split never cuts a
#           running order.
# B         srcfl/ftw#1799: planned charging and Charge now run on three
#           phases; the planner gets steps a three-phase order can deliver.
# #1795     srcfl/ftw#1795: a charger drawing against its order reads not
#           following.
# netting   no fix yet: a cut counts every order older than evSettle (20 s)
#           as shown, but a cloud charger applies it after 30-120 s, so Core
#           cuts twice, or too little while a raise is on its way
#           (ev_fuse_budget.go stepEVMeterLimit).
# D         after beta.2: plan a one-phase car at the rate it takes
#           (srcfl/ftw#1796, srcfl/ftw#1792).
# export    srcfl/ftw#1782, draft: an exporting phase counts as import, so
#           surplus never finds room to start.
# readback  no fix yet: surplus raises again before the charger applied the
#           last raise, then pauses when both land (surplus_reserve.go:128).
# relief    srcfl/ftw#1789, draft: the battery ends its relief before the
#           car's cut shows.
# hold3p    no fix yet: the app sends Charge now as 3p for an auto
#           loadpoint, and on a charger whose table stops below 4,140 W
#           Core floors the order to 0 W (fuse_limit).
